author: jane

trace.model: 4 NPUs (2 dies x 2), network-only timeline, REMOTE ops excluded

analytical.model: ASTRA-sim analytical network backend (congestion-free latency model)

booksim2_unicast.model: our booksim2 fork, cycle-accurate, snake 2x2 mesh, 8B flits @1ns

booksim2_multicast_fold.model: same fabric, dispatch sends folded into one mcast stream per flit (k=3)
booksim2_multicast_fold.notes: wall time higher due to per-flit packet simulator cost; cycle count is the network claim

claim_scope: NETWORK-LEVEL, cycle-accurate fabric, one batch slice, network-only. NOT end-to-end serving. ALLGATHER modeled as one-to-k MoE dispatch broadcast (ring allgather would not benefit). Snake-routing reachability: dispatch sources constrained to the snake head. Flit granularity 8B@1ns matches the bridge model in serving_level_headroom.json.
